description: Cross-repository research asset index. References existing assets without copying content.

cases.title: DDC Research Learning Store
cases.evidence: DDC commit 878ebbf; 3 tests pass; schema zachary.platform.research-learning.v1
cases.adaptation: Hub uses src/adapters/ddc_research_adapter.py to read/write compatible JSONL; does not duplicate implementation

cases.title: DDC Learning Cycle Bundle Builder
cases.evidence: DDC commit 878ebbf; read-only bundle builder with cross-repository completeness check
cases.adaptation: Hub shadow_lifecycle.py references its read-only, no-auto-promotion design principle

cases.title: DDC Evidence-Gated Learning Promotion
cases.evidence: DDC commit 878ebbf; promotion is explicit decision, not side effect; verified/promoted require evidence_refs
cases.adaptation: Hub capability_registry.py promote() enforces 5 requirements + validation pass; same evidence-gated principle

cases.title: DDC Research Benchmark Registry
cases.evidence: DDC commit 878ebbf; validates benchmark registry with required fields, duplicate detection, adoptability scoring
cases.adaptation: Hub CASE-LIBRARY.md 9-field quality standard references its validation approach; benchmarks/ directory reserved for future use

cases.title: DDC Five-Times-Daily Inspection Workflow
cases.evidence: DDC commit 878ebbf; read-only scheduled inspection across 3 repos; produces SHA/structure evidence
cases.adaptation: Hub research-validation.yml uses same read-only CI pattern; Hub does not run cross-repo inspection (DDC owns that)

cases.title: Z-Brand Learning Database (33 Cases)
cases.evidence: Z-Brand commit af28436; 33 research cases with star/license provenance; cross-repo audit report
cases.adaptation: Hub indexes these as reference cases; does NOT copy business case content into Hub. Z-Brand remains owner of domain learning.

cases.title: SICI Three-Repository Validation Gate
cases.evidence: SICI commit 6349682; added three-repository validation rules and verification gate
cases.adaptation: Hub THREE-REPOSITORY-VALIDATION.md aligns with SICI's existing gate; Hub provides centralized validation matrix, not a replacement

cases.title: SICI Evidence-First Research Learning Store
cases.evidence: SICI commit 6349682; evidence-first research learning store on mobile surface
cases.adaptation: Hub RESEARCH-LEARNING-SCHEMA.md ensures cross-compatibility; SICI remains mobile-side owner of its learning store

cases.title: SICI XHS RedNote Safe Architecture V2
cases.evidence: SICI commit 6349682; platform-specific safety architecture for XHS integration
cases.adaptation: Reference only. Hub does not adopt platform-specific automation code. Risk: account safety, must not auto-promote.

cases.title: GitHub Actions Reusable Workflow Verification Pattern
cases.evidence: DDC commit 878ebbf; workflow_call with runtime/test_command inputs; produces verification-report.json + test.log artifacts; permissions: contents: read
cases.adaptation: Hub CI adopts same verification-report.json output pattern; does NOT create reusable workflow (DDC owns verification execution)

cases.title: Dev Container Reproducible Verification Runtime
cases.evidence: DDC commit 878ebbf; mcr.microsoft.com/devcontainers/javascript-node:1-20-bookworm + python:3.12 feature + postCreateCommand; Node 20 + Python 3.12 + SQLite + ReportLab
cases.adaptation: Hub does NOT create Dev Container (pure Python, CI sufficient). Recorded as ADR-0001. Reassess if system-level dependencies needed.

cases.title: DDC Capability Delta Quantified Improvement Gate
cases.evidence: DDC HEAD 60fbecc; file blob 069e416; test blob ed72236 (13 test methods, static read; local run NOT VERIFIED); 7-gate quantified before/after + three-repo evidence, hold on any missing gate, AI confidence is not Evidence
cases.adaptation: Hub indexes the quantified-improvement gate as a future reusable-promotion reference; does NOT copy implementation (DDC is owner). Code candidate deferred: candidate for future adapter (R-2026-0003).

cases.title: Safe (Non-Harmful) Public-Data Collection Contract for XHS
cases.license: Internal (Zachary AI Platform); external models under their Apache-2.0
cases.evidence: R-2026-0003; full suite 73->101 pass/0 fail (Python 3.13 Windows exit 0), +28 offline tests; offline pipeline verified. REAL mobile-web E2E 2026-08-31: human-QR single account on rednote mobile web, search 广州太古汇, read-only list only (~3.6s/step), 20 real notes, zero risk signals, 20 nicknames redacted with 0 leak, audit completed (data/shadow/). Detail/comment-level and public-web launch remain NOT VERIFIED.
cases.adaptation: Hub owns the implementation-independent PII-redaction + hygiene-policy + collection-audit contract; Z-Brand collectors and SICI mobile surface consume it via adapter (no collector code copied). Public web exposes only redacted analysis conclusions; account/proxy pools forbidden on public path.
